eligibility.quote: The `bt_navigator` gets a `Failed to get result for compute_path_to_pose in node halt!` or a `Failed to get result for follow_path in node halt!` error, and the `controller_server` keeps on trying to follow the last received path.

failed_conditions.quote: [bt_navigator-12] [WARN]: Timed out while waiting for action server to acknowledge goal request for follow_path
[bt_navigator-12] [ERROR]: Failed to get result for follow_path in node halt!

loudness.quote: the `controller_server` keeps on trying to follow the last received path.

resolution.quote: Increasing `default_server_timeout` from 30 to even ~50ms solves this issue.

notes: Agree with all fields. BtActionNode timing out when waiting for action server goal ACK or cancel result led to desynchronization where controller_server continued executing un-halted path.
